label: THE DEFECT ITSELF — the column loses its floor and grows to its widest row, so every fold click moves the editor
the column loses its fixed basis and is sized by the flex layout instead
the floor comes back as `overflow-y: auto` on the COLUMN — which restores the width and takes the search box back into the scroll
from: .st-code-tree { flex: 0 0 210px; min-width: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; background: var(--panel); }
to: .st-code-tree { flex: 0 0 210px; overflow-y: auto; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; background: var(--panel); }
